title: a11ydebt: Audit Accessibility Debt in GUI-Agent Corpora

creators.name: Kraishan, Obada
creators.affiliation: College of Media and Communication, Texas Tech University

description:
a11ydebt measures content-description coverage, the share of UI elements that need a screen-reader label and have one, in the GUI corpora behind computer-use agents. It reports coverage per screen, per app and per corpus, with app-cluster bootstrap intervals. Version 0.1.0 audits Rico and AndroidControl, and it reproduces the corpus coverage numbers and intervals of the IEEE AISSA 2026 paper Trained on What Screen Readers Cannot Read: Accessibility Debt in the GUI Corpora Behind Computer-Use Agents (Kraishan and Jitkajornwanich) exactly.

The archive contains code only. No Rico or AndroidControl data is redistributed.
